events.evidence: India reports a record 200,739 new cases and 1,038 deaths from COVID-19
Israeli Air Force jets and helicopters strike Hamas-linked targets in the Gaza Strip
At least four people are killed and 17 others are wounded in a car bomb attack at a market in Sadr City, Baghdad

label.note: Record Indian COVID surge and Middle East strikes raise risk aversion; Baghdad bombing adds geopolitical risk.
